findings.location: line 4 ("We are in a battle; we must still overcome.")
findings.source_quote: We are in a battle; we must still overcome.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate without adding an explicit doctrinal agent. E.g.: "Tuko katika vita; bado lazima tushinde."
findings.translation_quote: Tuko katika vita; bado lazima tushinde kwa nguvu za Kristo.

findings.location: line 8 ("For he knows very well it will cost us our soul.")
findings.source_quote: For he knows very well it will cost us our soul.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the focus on the cost to our soul without adding other qualifiers. E.g.: "Kwa maana anajua vyema itagharimu nafsi yetu."
findings.translation_quote: Kwa maana anajua vizuri itatugharimu nafsi yetu kwa yote tulio nao.

findings.location: line 11 ("The darts of the wicked come from all sides.")
findings.source_quote: The darts of the wicked come from all sides.
findings.suggested_fix: Render "darts" and "wicked" faithfully. E.g.: "Mishale ya mabaya hutupiga kutoka pande zote." or "Mishale ya wapotofu huwadondoa kutoka pande zote."
findings.translation_quote: Misumari ya mabi kwa pande zote hutupiga kwa giza.

findings.location: line 2 ("The things that are bad will all be in hell.")
findings.source_quote: The things that are bad will all be in hell.
findings.suggested_fix: Avoid added or awkward modifiers. A clearer Kiswahili rendering: "Vitu vyote vibaya vitakuwa motoni." or "Mambo mabaya yote yatakuwa motoni."
findings.translation_quote: Mambo mabaya yatawekwa milele motoni moto wa maafa.

findings.location: line 12 ("When faced with God’s power, that devil—he hides!")
findings.source_quote: When faced with God’s power, that devil—he hides!
findings.suggested_fix: Remove added emotional qualifier. E.g.: "Ukikabiliana na nguvu za Mungu, yule shetani—anaficha!" or "Anapokumbana na nguvu za Mungu, yule shetani hujificha!"
findings.translation_quote: Tukikabiliwa na nguvu za Mungu, yule shetani—anaficha uso wake kwa hasira!

findings.location: final line ("Let’s take hold of God’s power! It’s time to respond!")
findings.source_quote: Let’s take hold of God’s power! It’s time to respond!
findings.suggested_fix: Translate both clauses without adding extra qualifiers. E.g.: "Tuchukue nguvu za Mungu! Ni wakati wa kujibu!"
findings.translation_quote: Tuchukue nguvu za Mungu! Ni wakati wa kujibu kwa imani na matendo!
